# IdeaProbe

> IdeaProbe is an MIT-licensed, open-source local web application for early product market research. Founders, indie developers and creators describe an idea, confirm requirements and search keywords, discover related products, analyze available reviews and discussions, and generate a report with source references. Users configure their own model and search API keys.

## Product documentation
- [English product facts](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/en/facts/): Capabilities, workflow, costs and limitations.
- [English Markdown reference](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/en/facts/index.md): The same product facts in plain Markdown.
- [Chinese product facts](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/zh/facts/): Separate Chinese documentation.
- [Chinese Markdown reference](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/zh/facts/index.md): Chinese reference in Markdown.
- [English homepage](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/en/): Overview and local setup.
- [Chinese homepage](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/zh/): Chinese overview and local setup.
- [Source code](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/IdeaProbe): Source, tests and installation instructions.
- [License](https://github.com/pauline-zhang-star/IdeaProbe/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license.
- [Sitemap](https://pauline-zhang-star.github.io/IdeaProbe/sitemap.xml): Canonical public HTML pages.

## Scope
The public website is product documentation only. The app runs locally. API providers may charge usage fees. No guaranteed search coverage, review count, market demand or citation placement. Reviews and discussions are distinct. Capability support requires evidence; unknown is not unsupported.

Documentation updated: 2026-10-16. This index is an optional convenience for tools, not a guarantee that AI search engines use it.
